A '''Givin''' was one of the crewmembers of the ''[[Hinthra]]'', a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by the [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Elis Helrot/Legends|Elis Helrot]], in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Along with [[Unidentified Givin 2|another]] [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] and a [[Unidentified Human (Hinthra)|Human male]], the Givin served aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] when it took on the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]] at the behest of the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Mal Biron]].
